beforeUnit.title: Everyday phrases, naming things, basic grammar, and gender
beforeUnit.topicSummary: Proposed Unit 3 is a development unit awaiting qualified review. It contains admitted records for gender, everyday phrases, and naming, plus separate book self-attestation. It is not installed and the owned-edition mapping is not signed.
beforeUnit.mappingNote: Proposed Lesson 3 mapping remains pending. The structural edition facts are unchanged. This proposed curriculum is not an approved alignment.

steps.title: Everyday phrases, naming, and grouping
steps.body: Proposed Unit 3 uses frozen dictionary rows and grammar excerpts for the groups, a small phrase set, and naming items. The owned book remains separate work. Qualified review is pending.
steps.bookDirection: Open Lesson 3 in the copy you own. The app records do not replace that lesson.

steps.title: Read the admitted grouping sentence
steps.body: The frozen page says: So, in Russian, nouns have an intrinsic property called 'gender', which comes in three types: masculine, feminine, and neuter. An ending is not a substitute for the admitted record.

steps.title: Four records in the first group
steps.body: These admitted records are listed as masculine. стол — table. дом — house. го́род — town. брат — brother.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Four records in the second group
steps.body: These admitted records are listed as feminine. кни́га — book. вода́ — water. шко́ла — school. рабо́та — work.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Four records in the third group
steps.body: These admitted records are listed as neuter. окно́ — window. письмо́ — letter. молоко́ — milk. мо́ре — sea.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Two records the page still places in the first group
steps.body: дя́дя and мужчи́на decline like nouns ending in -а, and they are masculine. Say decline for these nouns. Do not say they conjugate.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Remediation
steps.body: дя́дя and мужчи́на decline like nouns ending in -а, and they are masculine. Say decline for these nouns. Do not say they conjugate.

steps.title: Independent checks
steps.body: These checks use only admitted records. A miss returns to the explanation.

steps.title: Three short greetings
steps.body: These greetings are copied from admitted rows. здра́вствуйте — hello. спаси́бо — thank you. пожа́луйста — please.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Three short answers
steps.body: These short answers are copied from admitted rows. да — yes. нет — no. э́то — this is.

steps.title: Two written questions from the frozen page
steps.body: These written questions are exact frozen excerpts. Как дела? — How do you do?/How're things?. Где вы? — Where are you?.

steps.title: Remediation
steps.body: Return to the explanation. Compare the shown form with the admitted record. Do not invent a form that is absent from the record.

steps.body: These checks use only admitted records. A miss returns to the explanation.

steps.title: Two naming items from the frozen page
steps.body: These two items are exact frozen excerpts. Do not substitute another word into them. мой стол — my table. моя собака — my dog.

steps.title: Guided practice
steps.body: Choose the admitted record. The feedback states the frozen field.

steps.title: Two naming questions from the frozen page
steps.body: These two questions are exact frozen excerpts. Что это? — What is this?. Кто это? — Who is this?.

steps.title: Remediation
steps.body: Return to the explanation. Compare the shown form with the admitted record. Do not invent a form that is absent from the record.
